items.name: magnetic-button
items.title: Magnetic button
items.description: A button that leans toward the cursor and springs back when it leaves. GSAP quickTo, reduced-motion aware.

items.name: line-mask-headline
items.title: Line-mask headline
items.description: A headline whose lines rise from behind a mask, one after another. GSAP SplitText with autoSplit, static under reduced motion.

items.name: odometer
items.title: Odometer
items.description: A number whose digits roll into place like a mechanical counter. GSAP timeline, accessible value, jumps under reduced motion.

items.name: text-scramble
items.title: Text scramble
items.description: Text that decodes into place from random characters. GSAP ScrambleTextPlugin, screen readers get the final text.

items.name: copy-button-morph
items.title: Copy-button morph
items.description: A copy button whose clipboard icon morphs into a check with a small pop. GSAP MorphSVGPlugin, announces the copy.

items.name: directional-underline
items.title: Directional underline
items.description: A link underline that enters and leaves from the side the cursor came from. GSAP core with clip-path, keyboard focus shows the line.

items.name: squash-toggle
items.title: Squash toggle
items.description: A switch whose knob squashes and stretches as it travels. GSAP core, role=switch, no squash under reduced motion.

items.name: sliding-tab-indicator
items.title: Sliding tab indicator
items.description: Tabs with an indicator that slides and resizes to the selected tab. GSAP Flip, full keyboard support.

items.name: flip-filter-grid
items.title: Flip filter grid
items.description: A filterable grid whose items glide to their new places. GSAP Flip with enter and leave animations.

items.name: card-to-detail
items.title: Card to detail
items.description: A card that grows into its detail view and back. GSAP Flip, focus managed, Escape closes.

items.name: pinned-horizontal-gallery
items.title: Pinned horizontal gallery
items.description: A section that pins while vertical scroll moves its panels sideways. GSAP ScrollTrigger, falls back to a native scroller under reduced motion.

items.name: stacking-cards
items.title: Stacking cards
items.description: Cards that stack and shrink back as you scroll. CSS sticky plus GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub.

items.name: height-auto-accordion
items.title: Height-auto accordion
items.description: An accordion that opens to its natural height with contents fading in one by one. GSAP core, closed panels are inert.

items.name: scroll-read-highlight
items.title: Scroll-read highlight
items.description: A paragraph whose words light up as you scroll. GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub, read once by screen readers.

items.name: clip-path-image-reveal
items.title: Clip-path image reveal
items.description: A clip-path wipe while the image inside scales down, played once in view. GSAP core and IntersectionObserver.

items.name: svg-line-draw
items.title: SVG line draw
items.description: Strokes in an SVG that draw themselves as you scroll. GSAP DrawSVGPlugin and ScrollTrigger, drawn under reduced motion.

items.name: velocity-marquee
items.title: Velocity marquee
items.description: An endless marquee that speeds up and leans with scroll velocity. GSAP ScrollTrigger, with a pause button.

items.name: inertia-carousel
items.title: Inertia carousel
items.description: A carousel you can fling: it glides with the speed of your hand and lands on a slide. GSAP Draggable and InertiaPlugin, with previous and next buttons.

items.name: route-transition
items.title: Route transition
items.description: A curtain wipe between App Router pages that lifts once the new route has rendered. GSAP with next/navigation.

items.name: cursor-follower
items.title: Cursor follower
items.description: A dot that trails the mouse and wraps buttons and links. GSAP quickTo, decorative, mouse only.

items.name: toast-stack
items.title: Toast stack
items.description: Stacked notifications that pop in, make room with Flip, and swipe away. GSAP Flip and Draggable, aria-live.

items.name: draggable-bottom-sheet
items.title: Draggable bottom sheet
items.description: A bottom sheet with springy snap points you can drag or flick. GSAP Draggable, dialog semantics.

items.name: cursor-image-trail
items.title: Cursor image trail
items.description: Images that drop and drift behind the cursor. GSAP core with a reused element pool.

items.name: preloader-handoff
items.title: Preloader handoff
items.description: A counter preloader that hands off to the hero animation. GSAP timeline with the position parameter.
